## Lecture outline

::: {.lec-outline}
::: {.lec-group}
### Modeling foundations

- Model-based design and essential model features
- Mathematical representation of dynamic systems
- Black-box versus white-box modeling
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Identification workflow

- The complete system identification workflow
- Curve fitting versus system identification
- Water tank and practical engineering examples
- Frequency-response and nonlinear model structures
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Nonparametric methods

- Nonparametric methods using stochastic data
- Correlation analysis and frequency-response estimation
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Parametric estimation

- Parametric ARX model estimation
- Theoretical analysis of estimator bias and consistency
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Case study

- Real gas furnace system identification case study
:::

:::
